title: Criteria-key registry entry
description: One canonical criteria key: what it asserts, over what population, in what type, which integrations may answer it, and the evidence behind each implementation. tools/check_criteria_registry.py validates every file in contracts/criteria-registry/keys/ against this schema with a stdlib validator that REFUSES any keyword it does not implement, so a keyword added here is either enforced or the checker fails loudly. A field that cannot be evidenced is written as "unknown" (or the enum's unknown member) and holds the key at V0; it is never guessed.

name.description: Canonical spelling. Case-sensitive: Token-Service extracts transformedResponse[name] by exact match, so a one-character case difference is a different key. Unique case-insensitively across every name AND alias in the registry. Must equal the file's basename.

revision.description: Integer revision of this entry's MEANING. Prose edits do not bump it; any change to definition, population, evidenceRequiredForTrue or emptyPopulationMeans does, and must add a changeLog row carrying a V3 validation record and a shadow diff.

status.description: proposed: registered, not yet asked. active: one settled meaning. contested: production implementations answer it with incompatible meanings or types; valueType is not enforced and a conflict block with an open decision is required. deprecated: superseded; deprecatedBy is required and the name may never be reused.

definition.description: ONE sentence, written for a transform author to read BEFORE writing a transform: what true (or the number) asserts.

valueType.description: unresolved is permitted only while status is contested.

population.description: The exact set the value is computed over, and its denominator for a percentage. "unknown" when not evidenced.

polarity.description: Whether true (or a higher number) is the secure state.

evidenceRequiredForTrue.description: What a transform must have read before it may answer true (or a passing number). A pass from anything less is a false pass.

evidenceClass.description: measured: observed operating across the population. configured: a setting that would enforce it is set. presence: an object exists, nothing about its strength was read. entitlement: a licence, not a control.

notMeasured.description: Pinned for EVERY key. null is the only value that fails closed under every comparator (False false-passes lessThan/greaterThan via int(float(False)) == 0; 0 false-passes isEquals "0" as well), and the envelope is the only channel Token-Service's not-evaluated gate reads (VALIDATION-GATE.md, 'The sentinel rule').

emptyPopulationMeans.description: What a zero denominator means. A product decision made once, here, per key -- not in every file.

allowedCategories.description: Canonical category names (GET /integration/enum/categories, plus the five Network Security children it omits) whose integrations may answer this key. Canonical spelling only; category_match.py normalises case, whitespace and one trailing s. An empty list means unrestricted, which is correct only for cross-category evidence such as a licence.

integrationPolicy.description: any: every integration in an allowed category may answer it. listed: ONLY the integrations in allowedIntegrations may; Integration-Service rejects an RTA row for this key on any other SRN. This is the field that blocks the Okta case.

aliases.description: Other spellings that resolve to this key during a deprecation window. An alias is never a separate meaning.

owner.description: The person or team that decides this key's meaning. "unknown" until named.

conflict.description: Required when status is contested. States every position held in production today and does NOT pick a winner; a proposed resolution is a proposal, and decision.status stays open until the named owner rules.

existing.description: true when the key is already emitted somewhere in the estate; a split must reuse an existing key before it mints a new one.

level.description: The MINIMUM level across implementations (V0 when none is recorded). One V0 vendor holds the key at V0 in public. The checker recomputes it and fails on a mismatch.

citations.description: file:line, snapshot path or PR for every factual claim in this entry.

openDecisions.description: Questions that are not a type or meaning conflict but still need a named human -- typically which integrations may answer the key. Listed here rather than settled by whoever writes the entry.

srn.description: Integration SRN, lower-case UUID. An SRN is a public catalogue identifier, not a tenant id.

transform.description: Repo path of the transform the RTA row points at today, with the ref it is pinned to when that is not main.

notMeasuredConformance.description: Replay-backed, per path. A CI pass is not conformance: an allowlisted file passes CI and conforms to nothing.
